scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
